transcript: Speaker A: desi robot se English seekhoge? [Will you learn English from a desi robot?] Speaker B: tumhara high tech desi avatar dekhkar to main waise hi hairan hoon. [Looking at your high-tech desi avatar, I am already surprised.] Speaker A: to ab apni English high tech banao. Speakeasy app pe mere sath baat karo. [So now make your English high-tech. Talk to me on the Speakeasy app.] Speaker B: par agar maine bolte time bahut sari ajeeb galtiyan kar di? [But what if I make a lot of weird mistakes while speaking?] Speaker A: main hanse bina turant theek karungi roz. bas 15 minute mere sath practice karo aur dheere dheere confidence badhao. [I will correct you instantly without laughing. Just practice with me for 15 minutes daily and slowly build your confidence.] Speaker B: sach mein? phir to mujhe bhi shuru karna chahiye. [Really? Then I should also start.] Speaker A: bilkul yahan koi judgement nahi, sirf learning hai. galtiyon se mat daro. neeche diye gaye link se Speakeasy app turant download karo. [Absolutely, there is no judgment here, only learning. Don't be afraid of mistakes. Download the Speakeasy app immediately from the link below.] Speaker C: Abhi Speakeasy app download karein aur farratedar English bolna shuru karein. [Download the Speakeasy app now and start speaking fluent English.]
